verses.gurmukhi: ੧੧ : ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੋਂ ਛੁੱਟ ਹੋਰ ਪਰਚੇ
verses.translit_en: 11 : bhaau bhagat to(n) chhu'T hor parache

en.bdb: The valiant soldiers show their powers

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਰਤੇ ਲਖ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: sun sun surate lakh aakh sunaavahee|

en.bdb: Millions of the listeners explain His praises.
Researchers also run in all the ten directions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਿਰ ਜੀਵੈ ਲਖ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਓੜਕੁ ਪਾਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: chir jeevai lakh hoi na oRak paavahee|

en.bdb: Millions of long-lived ones have happened but none could know the mystery of that Lord

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਰੇ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਮਨੁ ਸਮਝਾਵਹੀ।
verses.translit_en: khare siaane hoi na man samajhaavahee|

en.bdb: Even being clever, people do not make their minds understand (the futility of rituals and other allied hypocrisies)
And ultimately get punished at the court of the Lord.
